about_the_game:
Marble Mash is a fast-paced arcade style clicker game where you try to rack up as many points as you can in a round.

Each round you are faced with the challenge of trying to click the blue marbles and avoiding the red ones. The pressure builds as gold marbles get thrown into the mix which earn you extra points.

This game also features a leader board so you can compete to rise to the top!

Do you have what it takes to be the Marble Mash champion?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 LTS or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo @ 2.4 GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 5000+ @ 2.6 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600 GT or AMD Radeon HD 3650 or Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: "Lightweight game for Linux/SteamOS, supports Steam Cloud (5 MB quota, 5 files)."

short_description: A quick arcade style clicker game. Try to get as many points as you can! Click the blue and gold marbles to get points. The red marbles subtract points!
